title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-06-10)
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf, re-downloaded 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes) by this session. HONEST SOURCING NOTE: this session's content-stream inflation of that PDF recovered only document metadata, not the footnote text, so the policy rule below is quoted as INHERITED from two sibling ledgers that did extract it (fomc-2027-03-17 and fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16), and only the arithmetic applied to it is this session's. The footnote states verbatim: 'The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday.' Jun 8 2027 is a Tuesday and Jun 9 a Wednesday, so the source's own worked example gives Saturday 2027-05-29 through Thursday 2027-06-10 with no inference of ours. INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED without re-doing the work: fomc-2027-04-28's initial research decoded the same PDF's vector grid shading directly (fill-colour ops tracked, legend grey 0.851 = 'Blackout dates', validated first against the 2026 page) and returned all eight 2027 windows, the fourth of which is May 29 - Jun 10 — the Board's own highlighting, matching this arithmetic to the day. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date: fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is 'tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', so the promotion trigger is the 2027-04-27/28 meeting, not a better fetch. Discovered during the fomc-2027-06-09 initial research, checked 2026-09-05
notes: The gate around the SECOND SEP of 2027 (fomc-2027-06-09, estimate), and its character comes from what sits at each end of the window rather than from what it covers. THE CLOSE IS THE FINDING: the gate lifts at the end of Thursday 2027-06-10, which is day one of the Bank of Japan's June MPM (boj-decision-2027-06-11, estimate) — so the first legal Fed voice after this decision lands on Friday 2027-06-11, the BoJ's own decision day. That is the June mirror of the asymmetry fomc-blackout-start-2027-03-06 measured for March, where the first Fed voice fell on triple witching, except the slot here is occupied by a central bank rather than an expiry. THE OPEN CROSSES A HOLIDAY: Memorial Day is Monday 2027-05-31 (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched 2026-09-05, its own cell reads 'Monday, May 31'), so the window's first three days contain a single trading session. WHY THIS GATE IS UNUSUALLY EARLY: the fomc-2027-06-09 ledger's leg 2 measured that every 2027 FOMC sits exactly one day earlier than its 2026 counterpart EXCEPT June, which sits eight days earlier — the 2027 calendar is 2026's with one seven-day block moved out of the April-to-June interval and into June-to-July (2026 runs 49 42 49 42 days between decisions, 2027 runs 49 42 42 49). That makes 2027-06-09 the earliest June FOMC in the 21 years that ledger parsed, and it pulls this gate into May, which no recent June gate has done. The corridor it covers is nearly empty by the standards of the March window: the +/-5-day sweep around the decision returns exactly one tracked event (the BoJ), against five for March. Estimate widens caution only and licenses nothing; promote once the 2027-04-27/28 meeting confirms the 2027 calendar, and the date re-derives from whatever it confirms.
